x:
Here's an idea: Read this free ebook: The Flinch 
The idea is simple: your flinch mechanism can save your life. It shortcircuits the conscious mind and allows you to pull back and avoid danger faster than you can even imagine it’s there. But what if danger is exactly what you need? What if facing the flinch is the one best way to get what you want? What are you afraid of? Here's how to find out.

http://www.amazon.com/The-Flinch-ebook/dp/B0062Q7S3S
